official_source_url.value: Embassy of Equatorial Guinea in Spain (official diplomatic mission site) lists 'Fotografía tamaño carné reciente' (a recent ID-photo-sized photograph) as an identical requirement across all visa categories it processes (diplomatic/courtesy, business/work, tourism/family visit, religious, transit, and Equatoguinean-origin citizens) — but publishes no explicit mm dimensions, background colour, or other technical specification.

cross_verification.note: Same finding as gq-passport: both the Equatorial Guinea Embassy in Spain and the Embassy in the USA (egembassydc.com/visas) publish visa document checklists that mention a photograph is required but do not specify size, background, or appearance rules. minexteriores.gob.gq returned HTTP 403 on direct fetch. Third-party aggregator figures (e.g. 35x45mm) are widely repeated online but could not be traced to any Equatoguinean government publication, so they are excluded per sourcing policy.
